title: Real Progress! Marble Machine Weekly Recap

author: Wintergatan
description:
This Saturday, Martin is joined by Derek Van Allen for a special Marble Machine stream focused on Onshape workflow and design strategy. They will look at topics that have come up in recent live sessions, including the Master Part Method, mate connectors, and how to structure complex parts and systems in a cleaner, more flexible way.

Using real examples from the Marble Machine, the stream will be a chance to dig into the design process, solve workflow problems, and learn better ways to build going forward.
